messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a quiet-window publish for py/ts SDKs tonight 00:30 UTC. Need final pin decisions and release notes pushed by 00:10. Release will rotate dist-tags + create release notes PR. TL;DR: GA for 1.18.0, soft-deprecate sync client.

deploy-bot: Publish job preflight OK on staging (dry-run). Will honor 'canary-pass' label. If deploy is run, job id will be printed and release notes link appended.

sam: Are we gating on canary for both py and ts? Can deploy-bot skip signer check if wheel signing drifts?

kevin: don't skip signing. If signer drift detected we abort publish and revert tag. We had a signer mismatch last week — cost us time.

anya: Docs — I can land a short 'what changed' + deprecation howto. Need a changelog bullet and migration snippet.

jen-docs: I'll open the release notes PR and add an auto-generated changelog. Maria drop the bullets pls.

maria: Bullets:
- New streaming client API with streaming chunks
- Soft-deprecate sync client (alias to async with warnings)
- TS: rename exported types for consistency
- Perf: batching default tuned for short sequences

sam: Rollback criteria proposal: any 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 5m on /v1/generate OR canary compatibility tests fail OR wheel signing mismatch at publish time -> immediate abort and pinback.

kevin: Add operational step: if publish fails mid-way, pin previous dist-tag, escalate to finance for usage freeze, and open a rollback incident tag. I'm on smoke after publish.

deploy-bot: Dry-run command used:
```
./scripts/publish --dry-run --cohort=nightshift
```
Dry-run completed: staging artifacts created, no signer errors.

anya: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/512 — added deprecation paragraph + migration snip.

maria: Can someone run quick dedicated smoke after the py publish? @kevin

kevin: I can. I'll verify latency, KV cache behavior, and token billing spike for first 30m.

sam: Request: stagger TS publish by 5m after py to give infra a chance to reconcile dist-tags and let web SDKs pick up changes.

maria: Plan: py @00:30 UTC, ts @00:35 UTC. I'll flip canary label at 00:05 to start automated checks. If all green, deploy-bot will proceed.

jen-docs: I'll publish the release page and add deprecation blurb. Tagging support and success teams for copy.

anya: Pinged support with short blurb (copied into PR). Will add FAQ entry for migration.

maria: Thanks everyone — unless objections I'll proceed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled publish 2026-03-22T00:30:00Z (job id: 98765) -- will post updates during the run.
